name: LY-2624803
summary: LY-2624803, also known as HY-10275, is a dual histamine H1 receptor and serotonin 5-HT2A receptor antagonist which was under development for the treatment of insomnia but was never marketed. It is taken orally.

pharmacology.text: The drug is described as a high-affinity highly selective histamine H1 receptor inverse agonist with additional strong serotonin 5-HT2A receptor antagonism or inverse agonism. The precise balance of these activities has not been disclosed. It was found to dose-dependently increase slow wave sleep in animals.
pharmacology.kind: Histamine H1 receptor antagonist; Serotonin 5-HT2A receptor antagonist; Sedative; Hypnotic

uses.text: LY-2624803, also known as HY-10275, is a dual histamine H1 receptor and serotonin 5-HT2A receptor antagonist which was under development for the treatment of insomnia but was never marketed.

sideEffects.en: Little is known about its effects in people. Drugs that block histamine H1 receptors commonly cause drowsiness, dry mouth and dizziness.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。阻斷組織胺 H1 受體的藥物常會引起嗜睡、口乾與頭暈。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。阻断组织胺 H1 受体的药物常会引起嗜睡、口干与头晕。

fact.en: Blocking histamine H1 receptors, one of its two main actions, is the same action that makes older antihistamines such as diphenhydramine cause drowsiness.
fact.zh: 阻斷組織胺 H1 受體是它的兩大作用之一，這也正是苯海拉明等老一代抗組織胺讓人想睡的原因。
fact.zhHans: 阻断组织胺 H1 受体是它的两大作用之一，这也正是苯海拉明等老一代抗组织胺让人想睡的原因。
